Cure FALSE dominates TRUE and PRE_MERGE veto precedes state change. IdentifyingEvent HashMap.values has no ordered priority; a single handler bypasses aggregator. PossessionStart retains last nonPASS; DENY/HANDLED short-circuit. Earlier HANDLED can bypass Penance and count successful without executing own start body. No universal veto precedence. Counter starts-1. Qualifying server updates increment then update, while nonqualifying state resets nonnegative counter to-1 and syncs. Amp1 requires nonvagrant; amp2/default accepts nonincorporeal else falls through nonvagrant. Mortal Null state qualifies; pure vagrant soul does not; amp1 vagrant possessing host can veto merge without accumulating, amp2 pressures that state. Fresh uninterrupted counter reaches600 on601st qualifying update, not600 world seconds; mortal reset0 then600 more. At>=600, amp>=2 possessed player calls stopPossessing and returns split=true,null. Nonvagrant demon calls splitPlayer(true) and returns split=true even when returned soul is empty. Nonvagrant mortal requests magic damage(amp+1)*4 ignoring accepted damage bool, resets counter0, returns false. Other branch can no-op. onApplied with retained high counter calls apply directly outside FX wrapper. Attempt FX and data snapshots cannot establish authoritative immunity. Forced demon split still requires not removed, state.canSplit and nonvagrant; forced bypasses only PRE_SPLIT veto. complete_original_object.full_chain_observation: 真实King注册，native getFightTasks装三个SummonMinions variant→Delayed.doDelayedAction→factory构造匿名召唤实例，覆盖isInvulnerableTo/tick/shouldBeSaved/setTarget。最终伤源IS_EXPLOSION或父类已免或有entity且PlayerUtil不能解析玩家/直接玩家owner即拒伤；无entity并不因该归属门拒绝。新增实例绑定当前boss对象，owner不存活或tickCount>12000则discard，不保存；addFreshEntity成功才factory返回实例，上层才扣energy、设攻击memory、生成召唤FX/声。
complete_original_object.concrete_observation: 三种实际召唤类共一个政策计1，不按LittleBam/Piglin/Embrake的实体名、spawn声、资源成本或匿名类副本重复。归属只接受Player、OwnableEntity直接Player owner、Projectile直接Player owner；不递归任意多级主人，不把所有宠物/反射弹等同玩家伤害。setTarget仅允许目标精确PLAYER类型或null，上层还直接写brain ATTACK_TARGET，不能声称setTarget阻断所有AI目标路径。召唤音/火粒子证明实例创建成功分支，非每次拒伤回执；tick的discard与无存档策略也不是文字提示节流。
complete_original_object.application_to_boss_immune: Boss拒控需分清source direct/owner解析与最终target资格，不能因没有Player来源就泛化拒伤为拒控。提示生命周期不能长于实际目标；召唤成功FX与拒绝反馈需要独立语义。
complete_original_object.limitations: 完整native getFightTasks、SummonMinions factory/handler及PlayerUtil归属函数已读。匿名Piglin最终门不依赖未取得LittleBam/Embrake基类；其super附加政策仅沿用API，不声称已展开三种父类所有免疫。SmartBrainLib延迟调度内部与外部Minecraft最终伤害仲裁未运行，不能称真实两端通过。精英副本未完整审阅不新增数。

complete_original_object.full_chain_observation: 实际Fox注册→原生rawTurkey交互→MoCTools.tameWithName容量检查后username写owner并发命名GUI/标tamed→Animal watcher20/Owner NBT（Aquatic21同模板合并）→Fox.attackEntityFrom先调用Animal：enableOwnership且owner非空且source.getEntity Player且username不同即returnfalse，在parent damage和health包之前→Fox不进反击分支；自由/出售卷轴和owner检查之前的OP reset卷轴会清owner撤去资格。允许且tamed时先sendHealth(packet12,entityID,dimension,getHealth)再parent，client当前loaded同ID Living直接setEntityHealth；本模组NetworkMod实际绑定客户端handler。
complete_original_object.concrete_observation: 一个实际持久归属身份保护的最终拒伤政策1，区别普通友伤保护（主人可伤、外部玩家拒伤的反向准入）、PNC同owner拒绝改归属、Goety异主捕获死亡取消。此前Crocodile仅给被抓受害者身份90%拒伤1，父Animal owner明确为未计上下文；本次扩展完整原生owner生产/持久/撤销/最终hurt链才新增，不再计captive。条件不要求getIsTamed，注释tamed非真实谓词；不看UUID/队伍/非玩家/null来源，所以不称全来源无敌。Fox中parent false阻断反击；Animal isNotScared true时parent之后恢复原target/清fleeing与parent结果无关。health是在伤前快照，拒绝分支不发，server对tamed另1/100 resync，所以不声称客户端永久残留旧HP。动物/水生适配、watcher索引、卷轴/来源名、health codec/GUI包装均0额外。
complete_original_object.application_to_boss_immune: Boss拒控灰字应在明确最终原因分支生成，不以HP快照/伤害false反推原因；包应有目标身份/维度生命周期与限频校验，用户名保护只说明资格机制，不能冒充现代Boss身份设计。普通阴阳不增灰字。
complete_original_object.limitations: 主岗逐个全文读取23个候选引用范围及整个client onPacketData包含方法、原生注册/NetworkMod绑定核对；不声称全文审完Animal/Aquatic两千行或每subclass前置副作用。配置声明/default未缓存，权限/宠物数量内部与命名GUI控件未全读，只作调用支持0；旧FML版本不是1.20.1移植代码。source归属引擎、真实同步/改名迁移/画面文字声音均未运行。

Main_findings: Allay registers LIKED_PLAYER and gift copies one held item, consumes according to instabuild then writes ordinary setMemory(UUID). Brain wraps ordinary memory in ExpirableValue.of(value) with Long.MAX_VALUE, unlike setMemoryWithExpiry. The UUID does not acquire a 600-tick TTL from noteblock handling.

hurt obtains DamageSource.getEntity and only rejects a Player whose UUID equals LIKED_PLAYER; no level lookup, distance or gamemode predicate at this gate. Parent damage and hooks remain outside this read. It is not a generic projectile-owner recursion or Boss control policy.

AllayAi.getLikedPlayer separately resolves in current ServerLevel, requires ServerPlayer in survival or creative and closerThan64. Failure returns empty without erasing the saved UUID. Persistent identity, active resolution and damage admission are separate states.

Noteblock is a separate GlobalPos+600 countdown-memory system; same block refreshes, other block does not replace an existing choice. Deposit resolver checks dimension/block/cooldown, erases invalid noteblock then falls back to liked player. Invoked give-item/navigation behavior implementations were not read here.

Local release requires nonempty Allay main hand and interacting MAIN_HAND empty; the local method contains no matching-owner check, clears held slot, throws the separate inventory, erases UUID and calls player.addItem. Outer Mob/network/permission admission and real inventory outcomes were not read, so this is not a demonstrated unauthorized-taking exploit.

Only sound and swing accompany gift/release; duplicate branch broadcasts event18 (three hearts), sound and item removal even if factory returns null; addFreshEntity result is unchecked in the factory. These are not successful ownership delivery receipts or per-attempt damage refusal reasons.

Living writes Brain through resultOrPartial and reads it only when Brain compound exists, through makeBrain plus ForgeHooks.onLivingMakeBrain. Brain codecs use registered module keys and codecs; optional expiry omitted for nonexpiring values. Partial parse/Forge replacement/defaults prohibit claiming arbitrary malformed state preservation.

Allay save writes DuplicationCooldown as long but read obtains int then casts to long; migration258 already owns this concrete narrowing boundary. It is not newly discovered or another count, and inventory/listener persistence does not establish player Clone transfer.

Allay item matching uses isSameItem plus asymmetric Potion checking only when the held sample has Potion. It does not inspect DynastyInfusion/cod4WarmWine/cod4PoisonSmoke. A carried base item therefore cannot serve as proof of one of the four paid NBT variants. Exact inventory pickup consumer and quest bridge are not expanded here.

dropEquipment invokes parent then empties separate inventory and conditionally spawns nonvanishing held item, clearing held slot. Actual spawn/pickup/loot outcome is unverified; holder removal clears Brain through Living.remove, distinct from saving and loading a fresh entity.

Existing370 already owns summoned owner-derived damage admission/lifetime; existing398 owns produced, persisted and revoked player identity controlling damage. Allay reversed protected-player predicate and narrower AI resolver are useful supporting differences, but do not justify another whole under the conservative existing identity-policy family.
